title: Test Your ElevenLabs Voice Agent: Testing and Simulated Chats
desc:
Agent testing lets you check an ElevenLabs agent before it reaches real callers. This episode covers the three test types and when to use each, turning a bad real conversation into a test, simulation tests with max turns and tool mocking, next reply tests with success and failure examples, tool call tests with exact, regex and LLM validation, and running tests from the dashboard, CLI or Python, including repeated runs with pass rates.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
